tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged. A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

content.content:
# State invariants

Booking and confirmation rules are checked by model-based tests: a small reference model plus seeded random event
sequences, every invariant asserted after every event. A new state bug gets a new rule id here first, then a test.
Design context: `docs/design/design.md` §6.

## Event alphabet
`quote(user, conv, origin, dest)`, `stream_done(conv)` (cards presented, nonces issued),
`user_message(conv, text)` (incl. negations and questions), `llm_request_booking(conv, quote)`,
`click_book(user, quote, nonce)`, `click_book_concurrent(user, quote, nonce)`, `replay_nonce(quote, nonce)`,
`clock(+Δ)`, `db_change(kind)` (leg removed / coordinate moved / unrelated row changed / file replaced),
`other_user_click(quote, nonce)`, `disconnect_reconnect(conv)`, `stop_turn(conv)` (R6).

## B. Booking
- **B1 Ownership.** A ticket exists only if its quote belongs to the user who clicked.
- **B2 Presented.** A ticket exists only if its quote reached `presented` (its full card was sent with `done`) before the click.
- **B3 Click only.** Every ticket is caused by exactly one `click_book` with a valid, unused nonce for that quote; no
  other event (in particular `llm_request_booking`, any `user_message`) ever creates a ticket.
- **B4 Validity.** No ticket for a quote older than 15 minutes at click time.
- **B5 Idempotent.** At most one ticket per quote, under replay and concurrent clicks.
- **B6 Fresh.** A ticket's legs, coordinates, distance and price strings equal a fresh recomputation on the
  `locations.db` current at click time, and the route is still the cheapest; otherwise the quote is `stale` and no ticket.
- **B7 Atomic.** Quote status and tickets never disagree: `booked` ⇔ exactly one ticket.

## Q. Quotes
- **Q1 No supersede.** Creating a quote never changes the status of another quote.
- **Q2 Button state.** The button state a client sees (after `done` or reconnect) equals the server's quote state;
  a card of a `cancelled` message is never bookable (R6).
- **Q3 Terminal.** `booked`, `expired`, `stale` never change again.

## Process
- Seeds are fixed in CI. A failing seed prints its shrunk sequence and is kept as a named regression case.
- Layers: pure model test over `airline/` → API driven with fakes (clock, LLM, locations.db copy) → UI scenario
  (ego-browser) for the click path.

## U. Usage limits
- **U1 Daily cap.** For every user and UTC day, messages let through ≤ `DAILY_MESSAGES_PER_USER`; counting and the
  reservation happen in one write transaction; a refused message stores nothing. (Model test:
  `test_reservations_match_a_reference_count`.) Known: the site token budget is checked at message start, so turns
  already running may overshoot it by their own cost; a `conversation_busy` message has already used its slot.
- **U2 One account per invite code.** An invite code maps to exactly one account, independent of the order of
  `INVITE_CODES`; the name is a display name only.

## S. Sessions
- **S1 Revocable sessions.** A session is valid only while its epoch equals `users.session_epoch` and its login method
  is still enabled; logout bumps the epoch (all of the user's sessions end).

## C. Concurrency
- **C1 Site-wide slots.** At most `AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS` turns hold a slot; a refused turn (`server_busy`) stores
  nothing and refunds its message slot. (Model test: `test_slots_model`.)
- **C2 Drain before release.** A turn releases its conversation lock and slot only after every worker thread it started
  has ended, or after the drain timeout (30 s, logged).
- **C3 Clicks hold no worker thread while waiting.** A booking click waits for the conversation lock on the event
  loop; its transaction runs to its end before the lock is released, even when the request is cancelled.
- **C4 Per-user caps.** At most `AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER` turns and 2 pending booking clicks per user at once.

## R. Stop (user cancellation of a running turn, #48)
Event alphabet for these rules: `send(conv)` (a turn starts, gets `run_id`), `stop(user, conv, run_id)` (the cancel
endpoint), `disconnect(conv)` (the SSE reader goes away), `model_token`, `tool_start`, `tool_end`, `persist`, `finish`.
Booking model (B/Q): `stop_turn(conv)` = the turn's pending cards are stored with a `cancelled` message and are **not**
presented.
- **R1 Explicit only.** A run is cancelled only by `stop` from its owner, naming its own conversation and `run_id`. A
  disconnect, a closed tab or a failed SSE read never cancels (the run completes and is stored). A `run_id` of an
  older run, of another conversation or of another user never cancels anything (404, nothing changes).
- **R2 Nothing new after Stop.** Once a run is cancelling, it starts no LLM request, no retry and no tool call; the
  model's HTTP stream in flight is closed. A worker thread that already started runs to its end (it cannot be killed).
- **R3 Drain before release.** C2 holds for a stopped run: the conversation lock, the turn slot and the per-user count
  are released only after its worker threads ended (or after the drain timeout, logged), and before its terminal event.
- **R4 One terminal outcome.** Every run ends with exactly one of `done`, `cancelled`, `error`, and the run registry's
  final state agrees (`completed` / `cancelled` / `failed`). A Stop that arrives after the steps ended (while the reply
  is being stored, or later) changes nothing: the run ends `completed`.
- **R5 What a stopped run stores.** Stop before the user message is stored (waiting for the lock or a slot): nothing
  is stored and the day's message slot is given back (U1). Otherwise: the user message and exactly one assistant
  message with status `cancelled`, holding only text that already passed ReplyGuard (no template, no click hint) and
  the cards of tool calls that finished before the Stop.
- **R6 No booking authority from a stopped run.** Quote and booking-request cards of a `cancelled` message are never
  presented: no nonce, `bookable` false, the quote stays `quoted` (then `expired`); a click on it is `not_presented`. Only a later *completed* turn can present
  it (e.g. `request_booking` shows its full card with `done`). Stop
  never creates, changes or reverts a ticket or another quote's status. A new quote in a later turn is bookable as usual.
- **R7 Well-formed history.** Every tool call of a stored completion has a `tool_calls` row: a call interrupted by Stop
  or never started is stored with error `cancelled`. The next turn's context gives the model `{"code":"cancelled"}` for
  those calls, never their result; aborted model calls never enter the context.
- **R8 Idempotent.** Repeating `stop` for the same run returns the same state and changes nothing more.
# 09-stop S1 — STATE (2026-11-24)

Issue #48, plan `docs/iterations/09-stop/plan.md` (decisions 1–5 followed as written). Branch `it09-stop`.
Coordinator approval (hc, 2026-11-24): `airline/service.py` gets only `present` / `status` keyword arguments with
defaults that keep today's behaviour, plus store migration v4.

## Done
| Unit | Commit | What |
|---|---|---|
| Rules + contract | `6a1af68` | `state_invariants.md` group **R (R1–R8)**, `stop_turn` in the event alphabet, Q2 wording; contract **v1.6** (additive): `X-Run-Id` header, `run_id` on the first non-ping event, terminal `cancelled` event, `POST /api/conversations/{id}/runs/{run_id}/cancel`, `Message.status`, how to draw a stopped reply; fixtures get `status`, new `sse_cancelled_turn.txt` |
| Backend | `9bed8c0` | run registry + `Agent.cancel_run`, `TurnStream.run_id`, cancel endpoint, stopped-turn persistence, store v4, context for stopped turns, tests |
| Frontend | `7189ce0` | Stop button (square, 44×44, replaces Send while a reply runs), cancel + abort, "Stopped" marker, stopped-card note, no stale updates after switching conversations, vitest |
| Screens | this commit | `screens/` 1440×900 and 390×844, light and dark: `*-1-waiting-stop`, `*-2-stopped`, `*-3-next-message` |

### Backend design (as built)
- **Run lifecycle** (`loop.py` `Run`): `queued` (lock / per-user / slot wait; nothing stored) → `running` (set right
  before the user message is stored) → `finishing` (steps ended) → `completed` | `failed`; or `queued` / `running` →
  `cancelling` → `cancelled`. The final state is set by the terminal event itself (`emit`), so registry and stream

  does not run the turn; needs a shared coordinator (cancel flag in app.db / Redis polled at step boundaries, or
  sticky routing by conversation).

  per-user count unwind; `on_not_stored` refunds the day's message slot; `cancelled {message: null}`.

  write may run); `_turn` sees it and starts no step.

  so a library that swallowed a `CancelledError` still cannot start work (R2). Any accepted Stop ends `cancelled`,

# State invariants

Booking and confirmation rules are checked by model-based tests: a small reference model plus seeded random event
sequences, every invariant asserted after every event. A new state bug gets a new rule id here first, then a test.
Design context: `docs/design/design.md` §6.

## Event alphabet
`quote(user, conv, origin, dest)`, `stream_done(conv)` (cards presented, nonces issued),
`user_message(conv, text)` (incl. negations and questions), `llm_request_booking(conv, quote)`,
`click_book(user, quote, nonce)`, `click_book_concurrent(user, quote, nonce)`, `replay_nonce(quote, nonce)`,
`clock(+Δ)`, `db_change(kind)` (leg removed / coordinate moved / unrelated row changed / file replaced),
`other_user_click(quote, nonce)`, `disconnect_reconnect(conv)`, `stop_turn(conv)` (R6).

## B. Booking
- **B1 Ownership.** A ticket exists only if its quote belongs to the user who clicked.
- **B2 Presented.** A ticket exists only if its quote reached `presented` (its full card was sent with `done`) before the click.
- **B3 Click only.** Every ticket is caused by exactly one `click_book` with a valid, unused nonce for that quote; no
  other event (in particular `llm_request_booking`, any `user_message`) ever creates a ticket.
- **B4 Validity.** No ticket for a quote older than 15 minutes at click time.
- **B5 Idempotent.** At most one ticket per quote, under replay and concurrent clicks.
- **B6 Fresh.** A ticket's legs, coordinates, distance and price strings equal a fresh recomputation on the
  `locations.db` current at click time, and the route is still the cheapest; otherwise the quote is `stale` and no ticket.
- **B7 Atomic.** Quote status and tickets never disagree: `booked` ⇔ exactly one ticket.

## Q. Quotes
- **Q1 No supersede.** Creating a quote never changes the status of another quote.
- **Q2 Button state.** The button state a client sees (after `done` or reconnect) equals the server's quote state;
  a card of a `cancelled` message is never bookable (R6).
- **Q3 Terminal.** `booked`, `expired`, `stale` never change again.

## Process
- Seeds are fixed in CI. A failing seed prints its shrunk sequence and is kept as a named regression case.
- Layers: pure model test over `airline/` → API driven with fakes (clock, LLM, locations.db copy) → UI scenario
  (ego-browser) for the click path.

## U. Usage limits
- **U1 Daily cap.** For every user and UTC day, messages let through ≤ `DAILY_MESSAGES_PER_USER`; counting and the
  reservation happen in one write transaction; a refused message stores nothing. (Model test:
  `test_reservations_match_a_reference_count`.) Known: the site token budget is checked at message start, so turns
  already running may overshoot it by their own cost; a `conversation_busy` message has already used its slot.
- **U2 One account per invite code.** An invite code maps to exactly one account, independent of the order of
  `INVITE_CODES`; the name is a display name only.

## S. Sessions
- **S1 Revocable sessions.** A session is valid only while its epoch equals `users.session_epoch` and its login method
  is still enabled; logout bumps the epoch (all of the user's sessions end).

## C. Concurrency
- **C1 Site-wide slots.** At most `AGENT_MAX_ACTIVE_TURNS` turns hold a slot; a refused turn (`server_busy`) stores
  nothing and refunds its message slot. (Model test: `test_slots_model`.)
- **C2 Drain before release.** A turn releases its conversation lock and slot only after every worker thread it started
  has ended, or after the drain timeout (30 s, logged).
- **C3 Clicks hold no worker thread while waiting.** A booking click waits for the conversation lock on the event
  loop; its transaction runs to its end before the lock is released, even when the request is cancelled.
- **C4 Per-user caps.** At most `AGENT_MAX_TURNS_PER_USER` turns and 2 pending booking clicks per user at once.

## R. Stop (user cancellation of a running turn, #48)
Event alphabet for these rules: `send(conv)` (a turn starts, gets `run_id`), `stop(user, conv, run_id)` (the cancel
endpoint), `disconnect(conv)` (the SSE reader goes away), `model_token`, `tool_start`, `tool_end`, `persist`, `finish`.
Booking model (B/Q): `stop_turn(conv)` = the turn's pending cards are stored with a `cancelled` message and are **not**
presented.
- **R1 Explicit only.** A run is cancelled only by `stop` from its owner, naming its own conversation and `run_id`. A
  disconnect, a closed tab or a failed SSE read never cancels (the run completes and is stored). A `run_id` of an
  older run, of another conversation or of another user never cancels anything (404, nothing changes).
- **R2 Nothing new after Stop.** Once a run is cancelling, it starts no LLM request, no retry and no tool call; the
  model's HTTP stream in flight is closed. A worker thread that already started runs to its end (it cannot be killed).
- **R3 Drain before release.** C2 holds for a stopped run: the conversation lock, the turn slot and the per-user count
  are released only after its worker threads ended (or after the drain timeout, logged), and before its terminal event.
- **R4 One terminal outcome.** Every run ends with exactly one of `done`, `cancelled`, `error`, and the run registry's
  final state agrees (`completed` / `cancelled` / `failed`). A Stop that arrives after the steps ended (while the reply
  is being stored, or later) changes nothing: the run ends `completed`.
- **R5 What a stopped run stores.** Stop before the user message is stored (waiting for the lock or a slot): nothing
  is stored and the day's message slot is given back (U1). Otherwise: the user message and exactly one assistant
  message with status `cancelled`, holding only text that already passed ReplyGuard (no template, no click hint) and
  the cards of tool calls that finished before the Stop.
- **R6 No booking authority from a stopped run.** Quote and booking-request cards of a `cancelled` message are never
  presented: no nonce, `bookable` false, the quote stays `quoted` (then `expired`); a click on it is `not_presented`. Only a later *completed* turn can present
  it (e.g. `request_booking` shows its full card with `done`). Stop
  never creates, changes or reverts a ticket or another quote's status. A new quote in a later turn is bookable as usual.
- **R7 Well-formed history.** Every tool call of a stored completion has a `tool_calls` row: a call interrupted by Stop
  or never started is stored with error `cancelled`. The next turn's context gives the model `{"code":"cancelled"}` for
  those calls, never their result; aborted model calls never enter the context.
- **R8 Idempotent.** Repeating `stop` for the same run returns the same state and changes nothing more.

1	"""The agent loop (design §4): one chat turn as a stream of contract SSE events.
2	
3	    user message stored -> [LLM -> tools -> cards]* -> guarded text -> assistant message stored
4	
5	The LLM chooses tools and writes text; routes, prices and tickets come from the airline through
6	the four tools. Text is released sentence by sentence after the ReplyGuard traced every number
7	and city in it; the first problem replaces the whole reply with a code template. The turn's
8	quote cards become bookable only when `Airline.post_assistant_message` stores them (`done`).
9	
10	Runtime (ADR-001): Pydantic AI runs the model stream and dispatches the tool calls
11	(`Agent.iter` + `node.stream`); this module decides everything else - budgets, retries and their
12	charges, the guard, cards, app.db records, time limits, cancellation and the worker-thread drain.
13	
14	Nothing here can book: the loop talks to the airline through `Toolbox` (four tools, no booking)
15	and `post_assistant_message`. Booking is the HTTP endpoint's call, caused by the user's click.
16	"""

272	    def stream_turn(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, text: str, *,
273	                    reasoning_effort: str | None = None,
274	                    on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
275	                    on_server_busy: Callable[[], Any] | None = None,
276	                    owner_checked: bool = False) -> TurnStream:
277	        """Start a turn and return its events: `user_message`, then `status` / `card` / `delta` /
278	        `replace` / `ping`, ending with exactly one `done`, `cancelled` (Stop, `cancel_run`) or
279	        `error`. The first event other than `ping` carries the run's `run_id` (also
280	        `TurnStream.run_id`).
281	
282	        `reasoning_effort` overrides the LLM's thinking level for this turn (none / low / high /
283	        max; None = configured default). `on_not_stored`: a blocking callable run (in a worker
284	        thread, before the event is sent) when the turn ends before the user's message was
285	        stored: refused with `server_busy`, or app.db failed to store the message
286	        (`internal_error`) - the API gives the day's message slot back there. It runs even when
287	        nobody reads the stream. `on_server_busy` is its older name.
288	        `owner_checked`: the caller already checked (off the event loop) that the conversation is
289	        the user's, so this method reads nothing from app.db (06 review P2-9); the turn's own
290	        writes still check ownership.
291	
292	        Raises before anything is stored: NotFound (not the user's conversation), ValueError
293	        (empty or too long text, unknown reasoning_effort). Must be called on the event loop. The turn runs in its own
294	        task: it finishes and is stored even when the client stops reading."""
295	        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
296	            raise ValueError("text must not be empty")
297	        text = text.strip()
298	        if len(text) > MAX_USER_CHARS:
299	            raise ValueError(f"text is longer than {MAX_USER_CHARS} characters")
300	        if reasoning_effort is not None and reasoning_effort not in EFFORTS:
301	            raise ValueError(f"reasoning_effort must be one of {', '.join(EFFORTS)}")
302	        if not owner_checked and self.store.get_conversation(user_id, conversation_id) is None:
303	            raise NotFound(conversation_id)
304	        queue: asyncio.Queue[Event | None] = asyncio.Queue()
305	        run = Run(f"r_{secrets.token_hex(8)}", user_id, conversation_id)
306	        self._runs[run.id] = run
307	        run.task = task = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_task(
308	            self._run(run, text, reasoning_effort, queue, on_not_stored or on_server_busy))
309	        self._tasks.add(task)
310	        task.add_done_callback(self._tasks.discard)
311	        return TurnStream(run.id, self._events(queue))
312	
313	    def cancel_run(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str, run_id: str) -> str | None:
314	        """The user's Stop (#48): cancel the run `run_id` of the user's conversation. Returns the
315	        run's state after the request (`cancelling` when this Stop was accepted; `cancelled` for a
316	        repeated Stop; `finishing` / `completed` / `failed` when it came too late and changes
317	        nothing), or None when no such run of this user and conversation is known (R1).
318	
319	        Queued (nothing stored yet): the run's task is cancelled; nothing is stored and the day's
320	        message slot is given back (R5). Running: no further LLM request or tool call starts and
321	        the model's HTTP stream is closed (R2); a worker thread that already started runs to its
322	        end and is drained before the stopped reply is stored and the lock and slot are released
323	        (R3). Only this method stops a run: a client that stops reading does not. Event loop only."""
324	        run = self._runs.get(run_id) or self._finished.get(run_id)
325	        if run is None or run.user_id != user_id or run.conversation_id != conversation_id:
326	            return None
327	        if run.state not in ("queued", "running"):
328	            return run.state  # cancelling, finishing or ended: idempotent, nothing changes (R8)
329	        turn = run.turn
330	        if turn is not None and turn.steps_task is not None and turn.steps_task.done():
331	            return "finishing"  # the steps ended in this instant; the reply is being stored (R4)
332	        queued = run.state == "queued"
333	        run.state = "cancelling"
334	        run.stop_requested = time.monotonic()
335	        log.info("agent.run.stop_requested run=%s conversation=%s queued=%s", run.id, conversation_id, queued)
336	        if queued:
337	            if run.started and run.task is not None:
338	                run.task.cancel()  # waiting for the lock or a slot; `_run` settles it
339	        elif turn is not None:
340	            run.tokens_at_stop = turn.budget.tokens
341	            turn.cancelled = True
342	            if turn.steps_task is not None:
343	                turn.steps_task.cancel()
344	        # else: the user message is being stored or the context built; `_turn` sees the state
345	        return "cancelling"
346	
347	    def cancel(self, user_id: str, conversation_id: str) -> bool:
348	        """Stop the user's running turn in `conversation_id` (any run id; tests and tools). True
349	        when a Stop was accepted. See `cancel_run`."""
350	        for run in list(self._runs.values()):
351	            if run.user_id == user_id and run.conversation_id == conversation_id \
352	                    and run.state in ("queued", "running"):
353	                return self.cancel_run(user_id, conversation_id, run.id) == "cancelling"
354	        return False

356	    def run_state(self, run_id: str) -> str | None:
357	        """The registry's state of a run (tests, diagnostics)."""
358	        run = self._runs.get(run_id) or self._finished.get(run_id)
359	        return None if run is None else run.state

361	    def _retire(self, run: Run) -> None:
362	        if self._runs.get(run.id) is run:
363	            del self._runs[run.id]
364	        self._finished[run.id] = run
365	        while len(self._finished) > FINISHED_RUNS_KEPT:
366	            self._finished.popitem(last=False)

368	    async def wait_idle(self) -> None:
369	        """Wait for every running turn (shutdown, tests)."""
370	        while pending := [t for t in self._tasks if not t.done()]:
371	            await asyncio.wait(pending)

373	    async def _events(self, queue: asyncio.Queue) -> AsyncIterator[Event]:
374	        while True:
375	            try:
376	                event = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), self.ping_interval)
377	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
378	                yield Event("ping", {})
379	                continue
380	            if event is None:
381	                return
382	            yield event

384	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ one turn -----------
385	    async def _run(self, run: Run, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
386	                   queue: asyncio.Queue, on_not_stored: Callable[[], Any] | None = None) -> None:
387	        user_id, conversation_id = run.user_id, run.conversation_id
388	        run.started = True
389	
390	        def emit(name: str, data: dict) -> None:
391	            if run.terminal is not None:  # R4: nothing after the terminal event
392	                log.error("chat turn: %s after %s dropped (run %s)", name, run.terminal, run.id)
393	                return
394	            if not run.sent_first:
395	                data = {**data, "run_id": run.id}  # the first event carries the run id
396	                run.sent_first = True
397	            if name in TERMINAL:
398	                run.terminal = name
399	                run.state = TERMINAL[name]
400	            queue.put_nowait(Event(name, data))
401	
402	        async def not_stored() -> None:
403	            if on_not_stored is not None:
404	                try:
405	                    await asyncio.to_thread(on_not_stored)
406	                except Exception:
407	                    log.exception("not-stored callback failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
408	
409	        # The conversation lock first, then the user's own limit, then a server-wide slot: a
410	        # second message of a busy conversation waits without taking a slot. Every refusal comes
411	        # before anything is stored.
412	        try:
413	            if run.state == "cancelling":  # stopped before the task began
414	                raise asyncio.CancelledError()
415	            async with self._locks.hold_async(conversation_id, timeout=self.lock_timeout):
416	                with self._user_turn(user_id):
417	                    async with self.slots.hold():
418	                        await self._turn(run, text, reasoning_effort, emit)
419	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
420	            task = asyncio.current_task()
421	            if run.state != "cancelling" or run.turn is not None or (task is not None and task.uncancel() > 0):
422	                raise  # shutdown, not a Stop
423	            # Stop while queued (R5): nothing was stored; the day's message slot is given back
424	            await not_stored()
425	            emit("cancelled", {"run_id": run.id, "message": None})
426	            self._log_stopped(run, None)
427	        except ConversationBusy:
428	            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": BUSY})
429	        except _UserBusy:
430	            log.warning("chat turn refused: user already has %d turns running (conversation %s)",
431	                        self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user, conversation_id)
432	            emit("error", {"code": "conversation_busy", "message": USER_BUSY})
433	        except ServerBusy:
434	            log.warning("chat turn refused: %d turns running, none ended within %gs (conversation %s)",
435	                        self.slots.active, self.slots.config.queue_seconds, conversation_id)
436	            await not_stored()
437	            emit("error", {"code": "server_busy", "message": SERVER_BUSY})
438	        except _NotStored:
439	            log.exception("chat turn: the user's message could not be stored (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
440	            await not_stored()
441	            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": NOT_STORED})
442	        except Exception:
443	            log.exception("chat turn failed (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
444	            emit("error", {"code": "internal_error", "message": INTERNAL})
445	        finally:
446	            if run.terminal is None:
447	                run.state = "failed"  # shutdown: the task was cancelled
448	            self._retire(run)
449	            queue.put_nowait(None)
450	
451	    def _log_stopped(self, run: Run, turn: _Turn | None, drain_ms: int | None = None) -> None:
452	        """agent.run.cancelled: stop-to-end latency, tokens charged after the Stop, drain time
453	        (log fields now; spans in #35)."""
454	        latency = None if run.stop_requested is None else int((time.monotonic() - run.stop_requested) * 1000)
455	        after = None if turn is None or run.tokens_at_stop is None else turn.budget.tokens - run.tokens_at_stop
456	        log.info("agent.run.cancelled run=%s conversation=%s stored=%s stop_to_end_ms=%s tokens_after_stop=%s "
457	                 "drain_ms=%s", run.id, run.conversation_id, turn is not None, latency, after, drain_ms)

459	    @contextmanager
460	    def _user_turn(self, user_id: str) -> Iterator[None]:
461	        """At most `max_turns_per_user` running turns per user (06 review P2-8). Event loop only."""
462	        if self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) >= self.slots.config.max_turns_per_user:
463	            raise _UserBusy()
464	        self._user_turns[user_id] = self._user_turns.get(user_id, 0) + 1
465	        try:
466	            yield
467	        finally:
468	            self._user_turns[user_id] -= 1
469	            if not self._user_turns[user_id]:
470	                del self._user_turns[user_id]

472	    async def _turn(self, run: Run, text: str, reasoning_effort: str | None,
473	                    emit: Callable[[str, dict], None]) -> None:
474	        user_id, conversation_id = run.user_id, run.conversation_id
475	        store = self.store
476	        conversation = await asyncio.to_thread(store.get_conversation, user_id, conversation_id)
477	        # From here a Stop no longer cancels this task: the user message may be stored (R5)
478	        run.state = "running"
479	        try:
480	            user_message = await asyncio.to_thread(store.add_message, user_id, conversation_id, "user", text)
481	        except Exception as exc:  # app.db timeout, the conversation gone: nothing of the turn exists
482	            raise _NotStored() from exc
483	        emit("user_message", message_view(user_message))
484	        if conversation is not None and not conversation["title"]:
485	            await asyncio.to_thread(store.set_conversation_title, user_id, conversation_id,
486	                                    " ".join(text.split())[:TITLE_CHARS])
487	
488	        context = await asyncio.to_thread(build_context, store, user_id, conversation_id)
489	        index = await asyncio.to_thread(self._city_index)
490	        today = store.clock().date()
491	        guard = ReplyGuard(index, records=context.records, user_text=text,
492	                           earlier_user_texts=context.user_texts[:-1], today=today)
493	        turn = _Turn(user_id, conversation_id, user_message, guard, emit, BudgetTracker(self.budget),
494	                     reasoning_effort)
495	        turn.messages = messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt(today)}, *context.messages]
496	        run.turn = turn
497	        if run.state == "cancelling":  # stopped while the message was stored: no step starts
498	            turn.cancelled = True
499	            run.tokens_at_stop = 0
500	
501	        self._running[conversation_id] = turn
502	        stopped = False
503	        drain_ms = None
504	        try:
505	            try:
506	                try:
507	                    if not turn.cancelled:
508	                        async with asyncio.timeout(self.turn_timeout):
509	                            turn.steps_task = asyncio.ensure_future(self._steps(turn, messages))
510	                            fallback = await turn.steps_task
511	                        run.state = "finishing"
512	                    else:
513	                        stopped = True
514	                finally:
515	                    drain_started = time.monotonic()
516	                    await self._drain(turn)
517	                    drain_ms = int((time.monotonic() - drain_started) * 1000)
518	            except asyncio.CancelledError:
519	                task = asyncio.current_task()
520	                if not turn.cancelled or (task is not None and task.cancelling()):
521	                    raise  # shutdown, not a Stop
522	                stopped = True
523	            except TimeoutError:
524	                fallback = [{"kind": "turn_timeout", "value": str(self.turn_timeout)}]
525	            except LLMError as exc:
526	                fallback = [{"kind": "llm_error", "value": str(exc)[:200]}]
527	            except Exception as exc:  # a bug or a store error in the middle of the turn
528	                if not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
529	                    raise
530	                log.exception("chat turn failed after producing output (conversation %s)", conversation_id)
531	                fallback = [{"kind": "internal_error", "value": type(exc).__name__}]
532	        finally:
533	            if self._running.get(conversation_id) is turn:
534	                del self._running[conversation_id]
535	        # an accepted Stop always ends `cancelled` (R4), also when the steps ended anyway in the
536	        # same instant (or a library swallowed the cancellation)
537	        stopped = stopped or turn.cancelled
538	        if stopped:
539	            await self._finish_stopped(run, turn)
540	            self._log_stopped(run, turn, drain_ms)
541	            return
542	        run.state = "finishing"
543	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("max_steps", "token_budget", "tool_budget"):
544	            log.warning("chat turn stopped by its budget (conversation %s): %s %s", conversation_id,
545	                        fallback[0]["kind"], turn.budget.snapshot())
546	        if fallback is not None and fallback[0]["kind"] in ("llm_error", "turn_timeout") \
547	                and not turn.outcomes and not turn.text:
548	            emit("error", {"code": "llm_unavailable", "message": LLM_UNAVAILABLE})
549	            return
550	        await self._finish(turn, fallback)

552	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ the steps ----------
553	    async def _steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
554	        """The LLM / tool steps of a turn. Returns None when the LLM's text can stay, otherwise
555	        the problems that make the template reply replace it.
556	
557	        One Pydantic AI run drives the steps: it streams each LLM call and dispatches its tool
558	        calls (one at a time, in call order, see `_sdk_tools`). `messages` is our copy of the
559	        context in the OpenAI shape (estimates, llm_calls records); a failed LLM call that is
560	        retried restarts the run from it.
561	
562	        Budgets (design §4.8): a step starts only while steps and tokens are left; each tool call
563	        runs only while calls are left for the step and the turn. A call that is not admitted is
564	        never executed: it gets a `tool_budget_exceeded` result (stored like any tool call, so
565	        every tool call of the completion has its result and the stored history stays well-formed).
566	        Once the turn's calls are used up and a call was refused, the turn ends with the template."""
567	        while True:
568	            try:
569	                return await self._run_steps(turn, messages)
570	            except _RetryStep:  # the step's retry count is on the turn (`turn.attempt`)
571	                pass
572	
573	    async def _run_steps(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict] | None:
574	        settings = self.llm.settings(turn.reasoning_effort)
575	        # no SDK request limit: the steps budget (max 20 by env bounds) is the only one
576	        async with self._runtime.iter(None, message_history=to_model_messages(messages), deps=turn,
577	                                      model_settings=settings, usage_limits=UsageLimits(request_limit=None)) as run:
578	            async for node in run:
579	                if _Runtime.is_model_request_node(node):
580	                    if turn.cancelled:  # R2: no LLM request after a Stop
581	                        raise asyncio.CancelledError()
582	                    if turn.attempt == 0 and (stop := turn.budget.stop_before_step()) is not None:
583	                        return [stop]  # (a retry belongs to the step already counted)
584	                    try:
585	                        completion = await self._llm_step(turn, messages, run, node)
586	                    except _Stopped as stopped:  # guard failure, or no retry left within the token cap
587	                        return stopped.problems
588	                    if not completion.tool_calls:
589	                        if completion.finish_reason != "stop":  # "length", "content_filter", ...
590	                            return [{"kind": "truncated", "value": str(completion.finish_reason)}]
591	                        if not turn.text.strip():
592	                            return [{"kind": "empty_reply", "value": ""}]
593	                        return None
594	                    if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
595	                        # far more calls than a step may run (06 review P2-3): none runs and none is
596	                        # stored one by one; the logged completion is marked so the next context skips it
597	                        refused = len(completion.tool_calls)
598	                        turn.budget.refused_calls += refused
599	                        log.warning("chat turn: a completion with %d tool calls; none run (conversation %s)",
600	                                    refused, turn.conversation_id)
601	                        return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(refused)}]
602	                    messages.append(completion.assistant_message())
603	                    turn.step_calls, turn.step_results, turn.step_logged = completion.tool_calls, {}, 0
604	                elif _Runtime.is_call_tools_node(node):
605	                    async with node.stream(run.ctx) as events:
606	                        async for event in events:
607	                            if isinstance(event, FunctionToolResultEvent) \
608	                                    and event.part.tool_call_id not in turn.step_results:
609	                                # a result our tools did not make: a name that is not one of our
610	                                # tools, refused by the SDK before any tool ran. It is answered and
611	                                # stored as before (`unknown_tool`, from Toolbox.run)
612	                                await self._tool_call(turn, event.part.tool_call_id, event.part.tool_name or "")
613	                    await self._log_tool_calls(turn, final=True)
614	                    for call in turn.step_calls:
615	                        outcome = turn.step_results[call["id"]]
616	                        messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": outcome.for_llm()})
617	                    if turn.exhausted:
618	                        return [{"kind": "tool_budget", "value": str(self.budget.max_tool_calls_per_turn)}]
619	        # a step without tool calls returns above, before the run could reach its End node
620	        raise AssertionError("the run ended without a step that returned")

622	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ tools --------------
623	    def _sdk_tools(self) -> list[Tool]:
624	        """The four tools as SDK tools over our own schemas and `Toolbox` (validation, structured
625	        errors). Sequential: one call at a time, in the order the model made them, so the budget
626	        admits them in order and the cards keep that order. `strict` off: the request carries the
627	        schemas exactly as before."""
628	        def body(name: str) -> Callable[..., Awaitable[str]]:
629	            async def run(ctx: RunContext[_Turn], **_args: Any) -> str:
630	                # the arguments the model sent are taken raw from the completion in `_tool_call`
631	                return (await self._tool_call(ctx.deps, ctx.tool_call_id or "", name)).for_llm()
632	            return run
633	
634	        tools = []
635	        for schema in TOOL_SCHEMAS:
636	            name = schema["function"]["name"]
637	            tool = Tool.from_schema(body(name), name=name, description=schema["function"]["description"],
638	                                    json_schema=schema["function"]["parameters"], takes_ctx=True, sequential=True)
639	            tool.strict = False
640	            tools.append(tool)
641	        return tools
642	
643	    async def _tool_call(self, turn: _Turn, call_id: str, name: str) -> Outcome:
644	        """Admit, run and record one tool call of the current step. The arguments are the model's
645	        raw string (from the completion), validated by `Toolbox.run`. The blocking work runs in a
646	        tracked worker thread: if the turn is cancelled meanwhile the thread still ends, and the
647	        turn waits for it (`_drain`) before it releases its lock."""
648	        call = next((c for c in turn.step_calls if c["id"] == call_id),
649	                    {"id": call_id, "name": name, "arguments": ""})
650	        if turn.cancelled:  # R2: never start a tool after a Stop (also if the SDK caught the cancel)
651	            raise asyncio.CancelledError()
652	        refused = turn.budget.admit_tool_call()
653	        if refused is None:
654	            turn.emit("status", {"text": STATUS_TEXT.get(call["name"], DEFAULT_STATUS)})
655	            turn.in_flight = call_id
656	            outcome = await turn.threads.run(self._tools.run, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id,
657	                                             call["name"], call["arguments"])
658	            turn.in_flight = None
659	            if turn.cancelled:  # the Stop came while the thread ran: its result is not used (R7)
660	                raise asyncio.CancelledError()
661	        else:
662	            turn.exhausted = turn.exhausted or refused == "per_turn"
663	            payload = refusal(refused, self.budget)
664	            outcome = Outcome(call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], payload["code"], payload,
665	                              error=f"budget: {refused}")
666	        # The outcome and its cards belong to the turn as soon as the tool returned, before
667	        # the row is written: if the time limit lands on the write, the reply still
668	        # carries the card that the stored row (written while draining) describes (P2-5).
669	        turn.outcomes.append(outcome)
670	        if refused is None:  # a refusal is no record a reply may quote
671	            turn.guard.add_record(outcome.payload)
672	        for card in outcome.cards:
673	            turn.cards.append(card)
674	            turn.emit("card", {"card": card})
675	        turn.step_results[call_id] = outcome
676	        await self._log_tool_calls(turn)
677	        return outcome
678	
679	    async def _log_tool_calls(self, turn: _Turn, *, final: bool = False) -> None:
680	        """Store the tool_calls rows of the step in call order (context.py lines them up with
681	        the completion), each as soon as it and every call before it have their outcome."""
682	        while turn.step_logged < len(turn.step_calls):
683	            outcome = turn.step_results.get(turn.step_calls[turn.step_logged]["id"])
684	            if outcome is None:
685	                if not final:
686	                    return
687	                raise RuntimeError("a tool call of the step got no result")
688	            turn.step_logged += 1
689	            await turn.threads.run(
690	                self.store.add_tool_call, turn.user_id, turn.user_message["id"], outcome.name,
691	                outcome.args, outcome.payload, error=outcome.error, latency_ms=outcome.latency_ms)
692	
693	    async def _drain(self, turn: _Turn) -> None:
694	        """Wait for worker threads the time limit (or an error) left running. A thread cannot be
695	        stopped; until it ends it may still write (a quote, a tool call row), so the reply is not
696	        stored and the conversation lock and the slot are not released before it ends - unless it
697	        outlives `drain_timeout` (store timeouts make that unlikely), which is logged."""
698	        if not turn.threads.running:
699	            return
700	        log.warning("chat turn cut short with %d worker thread(s) running; waiting up to %gs (conversation %s)",
701	                    turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)
702	        if not await turn.threads.drain(self.drain_timeout):
703	            log.error("chat turn: %d worker thread(s) still running after %gs; ending the turn anyway "
704	                      "(conversation %s)", turn.threads.running, self.drain_timeout, turn.conversation_id)
705	
706	    async def _finish(self, turn: _Turn, fallback: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
707	        """Persist the assistant message (the `done` moment: quote cards become bookable)."""
708	        text = turn.text.rstrip()
709	        if fallback is not None:
710	            text = fallback_reply(turn.outcomes)
711	            turn.emit("replace", {"text": text})
712	        elif CLICK_TO_BOOK not in text and any(
713	                o.name == "request_booking" and o.code == "ok" for o in turn.outcomes):
714	            # fixed by code, whatever the LLM wrote: the click is what books
715	            piece = ("\n\n" if text else "") + CLICK_TO_BOOK
716	            turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
717	            text += piece
718	        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
719	            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, text, turn.cards, fallback)
720	        turn.emit("done", {"message": message})
721	
722	    async def _finish_stopped(self, run: Run, turn: _Turn) -> None:
723	        """Store a reply the user stopped (R5-R7), after its worker threads were drained: only the
724	        text already released through the guard (no template, no click hint) and the cards of
725	        tool calls that finished; none of its quote cards is presented (no nonce, R6). Tool calls
726	        of the step that have no result - the one interrupted, the ones never started - are
727	        stored as `cancelled`, so the next context lines up with the logged completion (R7)."""
728	        for call in turn.step_calls:
729	            if call["id"] not in turn.step_results:
730	                started = call["id"] == turn.in_flight
731	                if started:
732	                    log.info("chat turn stopped during tool %s; its result is discarded (run %s)",
733	                             call["name"], run.id)
734	                turn.step_results[call["id"]] = Outcome(
735	                    call["name"], str(call["arguments"])[:MAX_RAW_ARGUMENTS], "cancelled", dict(CANCELLED_CALL),
736	                    error="cancelled: interrupted" if started else "cancelled: not run")
737	        await self._log_tool_calls(turn, final=True)
738	        message = await asyncio.to_thread(
739	            self._post_assistant_message, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, turn.text.rstrip(), turn.cards,
740	            [{"kind": "cancelled", "value": ""}], present=False, status="cancelled")
741	        turn.emit("cancelled", {"run_id": run.id, "message": message})
742	
743	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ LLM step -----------
744	    def _release(self, turn: _Turn, piece: str, first_of_step: bool) -> None:
745	        """Check the reply so far plus `piece`; send `piece` when nothing is wrong. Checking the
746	        whole text catches a number or a city name that spans two pieces (`St. | Louis`)."""
747	        if not turn.text:
748	            piece = piece.lstrip()
749	        elif first_of_step and not turn.text[-1].isspace() and not piece[:1].isspace():
750	            piece = "\n\n" + piece  # text of a later step starts a new paragraph
751	        problems = turn.guard.check(turn.text + piece)
752	        if problems:
753	            raise _GuardFailed(problems)
754	        turn.text += piece
755	        turn.emit("delta", {"text": piece})
756	
757	    async def _llm_step(self, turn: _Turn, messages: list[dict], run: Any, node: Any) -> Completion:
758	        """One LLM call (one attempt). Text is released as it streams. A failed call is logged
759	        and charged; it is retried (`_RetryStep`, after the backoff) only while none of its text
760	        has been released, retries are left for this step (`turn.attempt`, reset when a call
761	        succeeds) and the turn still has tokens."""
762	        attempt = turn.attempt
763	        request = {"turn": turn.user_message["id"], "messages": list(messages),
764	                   "tools": [t["function"]["name"] for t in TOOL_SCHEMAS],
765	                   "reasoning_effort": self.llm.effort(turn.reasoning_effort)}
766	        started = time.monotonic()
767	        buffer = SentenceBuffer()
768	        think = ThinkSplitter()  # an inline <think> block (servers without reasoning_content)
769	        thought = ""
770	        released = False
771	        content = blank = ""
772	        received: int | None = None  # output characters, once any output arrived
773	
774	        def log_call(response: dict, usage: Any = None, *, output_chars: int | None = None,
775	                     no_response: bool = False) -> asyncio.Future:
776	            # every attempt counts against the turn's tokens, also failed ones and retries
777	            charged, estimated = turn.budget.charge(usage, messages, output_chars=output_chars,
778	                                                    no_response=no_response)
779	            response = {**response, "budget": {"charged_tokens": charged, "estimated": estimated,
780	                                               "turn_tokens": turn.budget.tokens}}
781	            # `tokens` = what the turn was charged, so the site's daily budget (§8.2) counts
782	            # estimated calls the same way (06 review P2-9); `response.usage` keeps the report
783	            return turn.threads.start(
784	                self.store.add_llm_call, turn.user_id, turn.conversation_id, request, response,
785	                latency_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000), tokens=charged,
786	                model=getattr(self.llm, "model", None))
787	
788	        def got(n: int) -> None:
789	            # output seen so far, for a call that fails part-way; a complete call is charged from
790	            # its final response instead (`Completion.output_chars`, the same count)
791	            nonlocal received
792	            received = (received or 0) + n
793	
794	        def show(text: str) -> None:
795	            """Visible text: released sentence by sentence through the guard."""
796	            nonlocal content, blank, released
797	            content += text
798	            for sentence in buffer.push(text):
799	                if sentence.strip():
800	                    self._release(turn, blank + sentence, not released)
801	                    blank, released = "", True
802	                else:
803	                    blank += sentence  # white space is never sent on its own
804	
805	        try:
806	            # the per-call time limit; leaving the block (a guard failure, the limit, a
807	            # cancellation) closes the model's HTTP stream (on a real connection: at once)
808	            async with asyncio.timeout(self.llm_timeout):
809	                async with node.stream(run.ctx) as stream:
810	                    async for event in stream:
811	                        text = ""
812	                        if isinstance(event, PartStartEvent):
813	                            part = event.part
814	                            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
815	                                text = part.content
816	                            elif isinstance(part, ThinkingPart):
817	                                got(len(part.content))
818	                            elif isinstance(part, ToolCallPart):
819	                                got(len(part.tool_name) + len(part.args_as_json_str() if part.args else ""))
820	                        elif isinstance(event, PartDeltaEvent):
821	                            delta = event.delta
822	                            if isinstance(delta, TextPartDelta):
823	                                text = delta.content_delta
824	                            elif isinstance(delta, ThinkingPartDelta):
825	                                got(len(delta.content_delta or ""))
826	                            elif isinstance(delta, ToolCallPartDelta):
827	                                args = delta.args_delta
828	                                got(len(delta.tool_name_delta or "")
829	                                    + len(args if isinstance(args, str) else json.dumps(args or {})))
830	                        if not text:
831	                            continue
832	                        got(len(text))
833	                        text, inline = think.feed(text)
834	                        thought += inline
835	                        show(text)
836	                    response = stream.response
837	                _unique_call_ids(response)
838	                text, inline = think.finish()
839	                thought += inline
840	                show(text)
841	                completion = Completion.from_response(response, content)
842	                completion.reasoning += thought
843	                if completion.finish_reason is None:  # the stream ended early (no finish reason)
844	                    raise LLMError("LLM stream ended without a finish_reason", retryable=True,
845	                                   received=completion.output_chars, usage=completion.usage)
846	                rest = buffer.flush()
847	                if rest.strip():
848	                    self._release(turn, blank + rest, not released)
849	        except _GuardFailed as failed:
850	            # the stream was cut by us; how much (hidden) output it produced is unknown
851	            await asyncio.shield(log_call({"content": content, "guard_problems": failed.problems,
852	                                           "aborted": True}))
853	            raise
854	        except asyncio.CancelledError:
855	            # the turn's time limit, a cancellation or shutdown interrupted this call: it is still
856	            # recorded and charged (06 review P2-4); `_drain` waits for the record to be written
857	            log_call({"content": content, "aborted": "cancelled" if turn.cancelled else "turn_timeout"})
858	            raise
859	        except Exception as exc:  # every other failure of the call is a failed, logged, charged call (review P2-2)
860	            if isinstance(exc, TimeoutError):  # this call's own time limit: output unknown
861	                error, usage, received = LLMError("LLM call timed out", retryable=True), None, None
862	            else:
863	                if not isinstance(exc, (LLMError, ModelAPIError, UnexpectedModelBehavior)):
864	                    # not a known provider failure (an SDK parser error on an odd chunk, or a bug
865	                    # here): retried like a broken stream, with the original kept in the log
866	                    log.warning("LLM call failed with %s (conversation %s)", type(exc).__name__,
867	                                turn.conversation_id, exc_info=exc)
868	                if received is None and not before_response(exc):
869	                    received = 0  # a response body was read, with no output in it (e.g. not SSE)
870	                error = llm_error(exc, received=received, scrub=self.llm.config.api_key)
871	                usage = error.usage
872	                received = error.received if error.received is not None else (len(content) or None)
873	            await asyncio.shield(log_call(
874	                {"content": content, "error": str(error)[:300], "attempt": attempt + 1}, usage,
875	                output_chars=received, no_response=not isinstance(exc, TimeoutError) and received is None))
876	            if released or not error.retryable or attempt == self.retries:
877	                raise error from None
878	            if (stop := turn.budget.out_of_tokens()) is not None:
879	                raise _Stopped([stop]) from None  # no retry past the token cap (P2-2)
880	            await self._sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
881	            turn.attempt = attempt + 1
882	            raise _RetryStep() from None
883	        turn.attempt = 0
884	        record = completion.as_record()
885	        if _flooded(completion, self.budget):
886	            record["tool_calls_not_run"] = True  # build_context skips this completion
887	        elif completion.tool_calls:
888	            # the step's calls are known before the completion is logged: a Stop during the write
889	            # still stores a (cancelled) row for each of them (R7)
890	            turn.step_calls, turn.step_results, turn.step_logged = completion.tool_calls, {}, 0
891	        await asyncio.shield(log_call(record, completion.usage, output_chars=completion.output_chars))
892	        return completion
893	
894	    def _city_index(self) -> CityIndex:
895	        """City names for the guard, from the airline's current network (rebuilt when
896	        locations.db changes)."""
897	        net = self._networks.current()
898	        if self._index is None or self._index[0] != net.fingerprint.id:
899	            self._index = (net.fingerprint.id, CityIndex(net.cities))
900	        return self._index[1]
901	
902	
903	def _unique_call_ids(response: Any) -> None:
904	    """Some OpenAI-compatible servers repeat a tool_call_id within one completion (`call_0` twice);
905	    the SDK refuses such a response. Repeats get a suffix (`call_0~2`), in place, so the step runs
906	    as it did before ADR-001 (review P2-1). The ids are ours to choose: they only pair a call with
907	    its result."""
908	    seen: set[str] = set()
909	    for part in response.parts:
910	        if isinstance(part, ToolCallPart) and part.tool_call_id:
911	            call_id, n = part.tool_call_id, 1
912	            while call_id in seen:
913	                n += 1
914	                call_id = f"{part.tool_call_id}~{n}"
915	            part.tool_call_id = call_id
916	            seen.add(call_id)
917	
918	
919	def _flooded(completion: Completion, budget: AgentBudget) -> bool:
920	    """More tool calls in one completion than any honest step needs (P2-3)."""
921	    return len(completion.tool_calls) > budget.max_tool_calls_per_step * FLOOD_FACTOR
